seoTitle: Enable & Edit GoDaddy Website AI Automated Messages
metaDescription: Set up AI-powered automated chat messages on your GoDaddy website to engage visitors even when you're offline, with customizable tone and replies.
intro: GoDaddy's AI-powered automated messages let your website engage visitors instantly, even outside your active hours, by handling welcome messages, FAQs, and smart replies automatically. This guide covers enabling the feature and customizing it to match your brand.

steps.heading: Access chat settings in GoDaddy Website Builder
steps.body: Open the chat or messaging settings within your GoDaddy Website Builder dashboard to begin setup.

steps.heading: Enable the AI auto-messaging feature
steps.body: Turn on automated messaging so your site can respond to visitors even when you're not actively online.

steps.heading: Edit welcome messages and FAQs
steps.body: Customize the default welcome message and add frequently asked questions so visitors get useful answers automatically.

steps.heading: Set up call-to-action prompts
steps.body: Add prompts that guide visitors toward key actions, such as booking a call or checking out a product.

steps.heading: Customize tone and language for your brand
steps.body: Adjust the tone and wording of automated replies so they feel consistent with how your business communicates.

faq.question: Does AI automated messaging replace live chat entirely?
faq.answer: Not necessarily — it's designed to handle visitor questions when you're offline, complementing rather than fully replacing direct interaction.

faq.question: Can I customize the smart replies?
faq.answer: Yes, you can edit welcome messages, FAQs, and prompts to match your brand's tone and the questions customers commonly ask.

faq.question: Is this feature available on all GoDaddy Website Builder plans?
faq.answer: Availability can depend on your specific plan, so it's worth checking your builder settings to confirm access.

faq.question: Will automated messages work on mobile visitors too?
faq.answer: Yes, the AI messaging feature is designed to function for visitors browsing your site on both desktop and mobile.
